I am an applied economist and doctoral researcher at the Institute for Food and Resource Economics (ILR) at the University of Bonn.

My research focuses on land-use change, environmental policies, and impact evaluation, particularly in the Brazilian Amazon. I also occasionally write tutorials on spatial data analysis in R.
